title: Typed strict quotient trees and whole-system flatness
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and composable schemes $Z\xrightarrow hX\xrightarrow fY$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the strict complexes and operations of [def-pur-strict-quotient-expressions]. For $r\geq0$ define $\operatorname{Expression}_{h,f,r}(W)$ as finite typed trees with leaves $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(r)$ at $Y$, a coefficient-unit leaf at $Z,X,Y$, binary tensor at a common scheme, and pullback along $f,h,h\circ f$ (diagrammatic order). Interpret a tree on an $r$-tuple of complexes using exactly these strict operations, retaining parentheses. Define $\operatorname{SystemGood}(C)$ to mean that $C$ is K-flat on the entire coefficient sequence ringed site [def-pc-kflat-complex] and every integer-indexed term is flat there [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. These definitions assert no normalization or closure theorem.
